봉영여중 추가지문 - 3학년
주제찾기
1 12번 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
When the economy slows down, many people cut back on big purchases. They spend less money on expensive products such as designer bags. Yet they do not stop treating themselves completely. Instead, they spend a little on small luxuries such as a lipstick or a bottle of perfume. These items cost far less than a designer bag, but they still lift people’s mood. This pattern is known as the lipstick effect. It shows that people look for affordable pleasures even in hard times. A small treat can make a difficult day feel a little brighter.
①the reasons designer bags become more expensive over time
②why people buy small, affordable treats when the economy is bad
③how cosmetic companies advertise their products online
④the importance of saving money for the future
⑤the history of lipstick as a popular fashion item
2 13번 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
Sometimes one good thing about a person changes how we see everything else about them. This is known as the halo effect. If a classmate is great at English, we may assume that he or she is also good at math and science. We believe this even though we know nothing about the student’s real abilities. The same thing happens in advertising. When a famous star promotes a product, people tend to trust the product because they like the star. In both cases, a first impression shapes our judgment more than the facts do. So it is wise to judge people and products by their actual qualities.
①the importance of learning English well
②how celebrities become famous through advertising
③ways to make a good first impression on others
④why students should study math and science together
⑤how one good quality can affect our overall judgment

봉영여중 추가지문 - 3학년
요지찾기
3 12번 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
People do not give up every pleasure when money is tight. During an economic slump, they stop spending on costly products like designer bags. However, they still want something to brighten their everyday lives. So they turn to cheaper treats, such as a new lipstick or a small bottle of perfume. These little purchases are easy on the wallet but still make them feel good. This pattern is called the lipstick effect. It reminds us that the wish to enjoy life does not disappear in hard times. People simply find more affordable ways to satisfy it.
①경기가 나빠지면 사람들은 모든 소비를 멈춘다.
②비싼 제품일수록 사람들에게 더 큰 행복을 준다.
③불황기에는 화장품 회사의 매출이 크게 줄어든다.
④어려운 시기에도 사람들은 감당할 수 있는 작은 즐거움을 찾는다.
⑤돈을 아끼려면 작은 사치품부터 줄여야 한다.
4 13번 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
Have you ever thought someone was smart in every subject just because they were good at one? This is the halo effect at work. One good quality of a person or product makes us think well of their other qualities too. For instance, a student who speaks excellent English may seem like a math and science star as well. Advertising uses this effect when a popular celebrity promotes a product. Fans often believe the product is excellent simply because they like the celebrity. Such judgments come from first impressions, not from facts. We should therefore judge people and products by what they are really like.
①좋은 첫인상을 남기는 것이 성공의 열쇠이다.
②유명인이 광고하는 제품은 품질을 믿어도 된다.
③한 가지 장점에 휘둘리지 말고 실제 특성으로 판단해야 한다.
④영어를 잘하는 학생은 다른 과목도 잘한다.
⑤광고는 소비자에게 정확한 정보를 제공한다.
